name: Commute.geom_sum₂
statement: Commute x y) (h : x ≠ y) (n : ℕ) : ∑ i ∈ range n, x ^ i * y ^ (n - 1 - i) = (x ^ n - y ^ n) / (x - y)

name: geom_sum_eq
statement: x ≠ 1) (n : ℕ) : ∑ i ∈ range n, x ^ i = (x ^ n - 1) / (x - 1)

name: Commute.geom_sum₂_Ico
statement: Commute x y) (hxy : x ≠ y) {m n : ℕ} (hmn : m ≤ n) : ∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico m n, x ^ i * y ^ (n - 1 - i) = (x ^ n - y ^ (n - m) * x ^ m) / (x - y)

name: geom_sum_inv
statement: x ≠ 1) (hx0 : x ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) : ∑ i ∈ range n, x⁻¹ ^ i = (x - 1)⁻¹ * (x - x⁻¹ ^ n * x)

have_tree.name: h₁
have_tree.body: by rwa [inv_eq_one_div, Ne, div_eq_iff_mul_eq hx0, one_mul]
